name: memory-loop
description: A memory lifecycle for Claude Code's native file-based memory: a save gate against hallucinated memories, tiered expiry (short-tier memories archived — never deleted — when they lapse), a propose-then-confirm consolidation pass (merge/dedupe long-tier memory), a periodic learning-review nudge, a two-file habit frame (rules always loaded, case records on demand), and an optional identity setup (names for the user and the assistant). Local-only, English, no org-specific content.
